en: The Marvelous Bridge goes all the way over the canyon to Route 15. Mind the wind.
text: Podul Minunat trece peste tot canionul până la Traseul 15. Ai grijă la vânt.

en: My parasol nearly flew away on the bridge. I hold it with both hands now.
text: Umbrela mea aproape a zburat de pe pod. Acum o țin cu ambele mâini.

en: Nimbasa City is just west of here. Its amusement park is lovely at night.
text: Nimbasa City e chiar la vest de aici. Parcul ei de distracții e minunat noaptea.
